content_sections.heading: NHM-TN Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The Virudhunagar District Health Society is engaging Staff Nurses as per NHM norms for the Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) institutions, including the Special Newborn Care Unit (SNCU) and Paediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU). The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About NHM-TN
content_sections.text: The National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN) works under the Tamil Nadu Health and Family Welfare Department. In this notice the Virudhunagar District Health Society, which functions under the District Collector as its chairman and the District Health Officer as its Executive Secretary, engages the Staff Nurses.

content_sections.heading: NHM-TN Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice announces 59 vacancies for a single post. The number of vacancies is subject to change. The notice says the district-wise vacancy details can be downloaded from the NHM-TN website https://nhm.tn.gov.in/ and https://virudhunagar.nic.in/ .

content_sections.heading: NHM-TN Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: NHM-TN Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Staff Nurse is "Upto 50 years". The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM-TN Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application form and the district-wise vacancy details from the NHM-TN website ( https://nhm.tn.gov.in/ ) or https://virudhunagar.nic.in/ . Fill in the application form. Enclose photocopies of the relevant documents with the filled application. Address the application to: To, District Health Officer / The Executive Secretary, District Health Office, District Health Society, New Collectorate 1st Floor, R.No 126, Virudhunagar. The application with the documents should reach this address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: NHM-TN Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis and purely temporary in nature, as per NHM norms. The engagement does not confer any right to claim regularization. Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O.(Ms).No 427, Health and Family Welfare EAP-I/1 department, dated 18.11.2026. The number of vacancies is subject to change.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in NHM-TN Virudhunagar?
faq.answer: There are 59 vacancies for Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, and the notice says the number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application with documents should reach the District Health Society office on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NHM-TN Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates need GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
Q5. What is the salary of a Staff Nurse under NHM-TN?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.21000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Get the application form from https://nhm.tn.gov.in/ or https://virudhunagar.nic.in/, fill it in, attach photocopies of the relevant documents and send it to the District Health Officer / The Executive Secretary, District Health Society, New Collectorate 1st Floor, R.No 126, Virudhunagar.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract basis and purely temporary in nature, and it does not confer any right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q8. Where will selected candidates be placed?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O.(Ms).No 427, Health and Family Welfare EAP-I/1 department, dated 18.11.2026.
